mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which raises the cost of capital and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% per month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return exceeds the risk-free rate by more than 150 basis points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which erode consumer purchasing power and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower during triggered periods compared to non-triggered periods at the 5% significance level.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent month-over-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically distinguishable from zero.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and the Consumer Price Index above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a dual tightening and inflationary shock, which increases discount rates and reduces real earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during co-activation of both proxies, or the interaction term is not statistically significant in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals a recovery in residential investment, which boosts construction-related equities and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods, or the median return is less than the risk-free rate.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both payroll employment (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is a contradictory signal that often precedes a data revision or measurement error; under such conditions, S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days tend to be highly volatile and are more likely to be negative.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE increases in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered months, or the event occurs fewer than 3 times in a 5-year sample.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in Real Personal Income (proxied by RSAFS) of more than 0.3% for five consecutive months signals a broad-based weakening in household purchasing power, which reduces demand for goods and services and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS monthly change < -0.3% for 5 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero during triggered periods, or the event is not followed by a recession within the next 12 months.
